english.title: Packaging seller fail to maintain and retain records - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a producer of packaging waste who was a seller of packaging, failed to maintain for each data collection period, and retain for at least 7 years after the end of that data collection period, records of information referred to in paragraph 20(a) or 20(c) of Schedule 1 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(5) and 28(2)(a) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and placebeing a producer of packaging waste who was a seller of packagingfailed to maintain for each data collection period,the information required of a small producer by regulation 16(5)(a) OR a large producer by regulation 16(5)(b)
and retain for at least 7 years
